title: 2.2.17 For + While Loop Program (Part B)
description: Write a JS program with at least one for loop and one while loop that solves a counting or accumulation problem. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: A2.2.1 Part B per curriculum-plan.md §2.2 ('a JS program using at least one for loop and one while loop...'); pairs with 2.2.8 A2.2.1 (Part A) and the 2.2.7 A2.2.0 gate chart

steps.title: Write a for-loop counting task
steps.instructions: Use a for loop to count or step through a range of numbers, logging something on each pass, for example, counting how many multiples of a number appear in a range.

steps.title: Write a while-loop accumulation task
steps.instructions: Use a while loop to build up a running total (an accumulator) and log the final total when the loop finishes.

steps.title: Comment your steps
steps.instructions: Add a short comment above each loop explaining what it does. This should match the algorithm you charted in 2.2.7, if your program ended up doing something different than your chart, add a comment saying what changed and why.
